card.name: Earthquake news and cord clamping
card.fires_on: Words in a few repeated passages: "no immediate" reports of damage after a quake, tsunami alert wording, and "umbilical cord is clamped" in cesarean dosing. Also inside "glaucoma".

modes.label: Quake news wording
modes.description: Words in earthquake reports, especially "immediate" after "no" and the words that follow it.
modes.example: There were no<< immediate>> reports of serious damage or injury.

modes.label: Cord clamping in cesarean dosing
modes.description: Words in the phrase about giving the first dose once the umbilical cord is clamped.
modes.example: as soon as the umbilical<< cord>> is clamped.

modes.label: Glaucoma spelling
modes.description: The middle of the word glaucoma in a warning about untreated angle-closure glaucoma.
modes.example: Untreated acute angle-closure gl<<au>>coma can lead to permanent vision loss.

card.writes: It suppresses words like immediate and immediately and promotes unrelated year-count and healing words, so no clear single effect.
